name: Filled Jade Phial
summary: In Dolanaar, the Filled Jade Phial is carried back with sacred water from Starbreeze Village. The water helps replenish the central wells while young night elves learn their people's history.

sections.title: Waters of Starbreeze
sections.body: Druids in Darnassus draw sacred moonwell water from across Teldrassil to replenish their central wells. Corithras Moonrage entrusts young travelers in Dolanaar with a jade phial made to hold the pure water safely. The moonwell outside Starbreeze Village lies east of Dolanaar. Initiates collect its water as they tend the World Tree.

sections.title: A Lesson in History
sections.body: When you bring the Filled Jade Phial back to Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage shares another chapter of kaldorei history. He tells of the years after the Third War, when Nordrassil burned, night elves lost their immortality, the Betrayer was released, and Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared.

faq.q: Where is the Jade Phial filled?
aliases: where do i fill the jade phial
how to get filled jade phial
faq.answer: Fill the Jade Phial at the sacred moonwell just outside Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar on Teldrassil.

faq.q: Who requires the Filled Jade Phial?
aliases: who wants the filled jade phial
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage, an elder night elf in Dolanaar, asks travelers to fetch the water for the Crown of the Earth ritual.

faq.q: Why are moonwell waters collected in phials like this?
aliases: what is the jade phial for
faq.answer: Druids in Darnassus use specially crafted vessels like the Jade Phial to carry pure water from Teldrassil's outlying wells and replenish their primary moonwells.

faq.q: What history does Corithras share when turning this in?
faq.answer: When Corithras Moonrage receives the filled phial, he tells of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal: the loss of night elf immortality, the release of Illidan Stormrage, and the unexplained disappearance of Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage.

angles.text: As a young kaldorei, fetching the water honors your sacred duty to Teldrassil. Corithras also teaches you about the loss of night elf immortality after Mount Hyjal.
As a druid, tending the moonwells connects you to the restorative magic that sustains Darnassus and the Cenarion Circle's work to nurture the young World Tree.
